page.overview:
Who is Eve Byre?

Eve Byre was a human female who served as a Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. After the death of her first Padawan, Zaph Mora, she took on another Padawan, Cam Lindon.

In 228 BBY, Eve Byre travelled onboard the Vessel with her Padawan Zaph Mora to Oisin to deliver supplies to the locals. During the trip, she and Zaph sparred and meditated. When Affie Hollow came to check on them, she explained that their mission was to help the Oisinians to develop a sustainable society regardless of what disruptions the Nihil conflict might have caused. As they prepared to land on Oisin, they crossed paths with a Nihil ship coming to raid the planet. She ordered the crew to bring the Vessel twenty meters above the raiding ship and then jumped out with her Padawan. They breached the hull of the Nihil ship and caused it to crash land. After downing the ship, she directed the Osinian soldiers to secure three Nihil prisoners. She thanked Hollow for her help after the cargo was unloaded. Hollow gave her a specialized comlink with a homing device that was directly connected to the Vessel so Byre could contact them when she needed to be picked up. Byre and Mora stayed on Oisin to help the Oisians with their fortification plans. While there, the Jedi hunter Sicarus landed on the planet and attacked the two Jedi with a pack of Nameless. Byre was captured when she was overwhelmed by the effect of the creatures. She was kept in a cage on Sicarus's shuttle when he travelled to Tolis to kill Reath Silas and Cohmac Vitus. Left alone when Sicarus took the Nameless to hunt the Jedi, she managed to activate the homing signal on the comlink she had gotten from Hollow. She was almost catatonic and covered in filth when she was rescued by Hollow from the cage she was confined to. Byre was returned to Coruscant for treatment and care at the Jedi Temple. She was visited by Hollow and thanked the woman for rescuing her. They talked about Mora's death and how Byre was doing in her recovery.

Following her rescue and recovery, Eve Byre took Cam Lindon as her Padawan. The two were joined by Alcedian Jedi Initiates Tep Tep and Kildo aboard the Innovator for a scientific mission studying the Blight, but following a request by Jedi Master Ackmora, the Innovator instead traveled to Barraza City on Eiram to investigate a series of missing people. The culprits were the Drengir, who survived in the Eiram oceans following the fall of Starlight Beacon.

Eve Byre first appeared in the 2024 young-adult novel The High Republic: Tears of the Nameless, written by George Mann and published as part of the Star Wars: The High Republic multimedia project's In an interview, Mann stated that Byre was key to future The High Republic storytelling.
